title: Xi: US-China relationship will be one of strategic stability based on respect, fairness and reciprocity
description: Xi: Agreed with Trump to add new substance to US-China relationship Trump on China: We've made tremendous strides for both countries in meetings We will be speaking a lot It's not like we're breaking any new ground here but this is a nice departure from the constant China fighting that has characterized much of Trump's tenure, and his entire public persona since he entered into politics.  This article was written by Adam Button at investinglive.com.

title: Tehran describes talks atmosphere as increasingly positive - report
description: Al Jazeera's bureau chief in Tehran, Nourddine Dgheir, citing sources in the city, says the atmosphere around talks is increasingly positive. He writes that Iran-U.S. negotiations, which are ongoing in New York, have moved beyond initial diplomatic contacts into a more detailed technical phase, with technical experts joining the discussion. More Iranian officials have travelled to New York for the talks. The report says Qatar continues to mediate. title: Trump will meet with Xi again in November
description: Trump says he will meet with Xi again in November and then again at the G20 in DDecember in Miami. Trump said the meeting was one of friendship, strength and success for both the USA and China. This article was written by Adam Button at investinglive.com.
